paraphrase: Whether the ultimate is an affirming or non-affirming negation: for the provisional, enumerated ultimate the emptiness that negates true existence is a non-affirming negation; the actual ultimate, realized in meditative equipoise, is the union of appearance and emptiness beyond all four extremes — neither kind of negation.
speaker: Mipham
notes: Reference from the unit author's knowledge (not read in a local text in this phase).

paraphrase: Whether to analyse or to rest: analytical meditation produces certainty, and resting meditation lets that certainty settle without concepts; the two are to be alternated, the analysis of the paṇḍita and the resting of the kusāli supporting one another.
speaker: Mipham
notes: Reference from the unit author's knowledge (not read in a local text in this phase).

paraphrase: Whether Madhyamaka has a thesis: from the standpoint of the ultimate free of extremes, there is no thesis to hold; conventionally, the Mādhyamika asserts, teaches and refutes.
speaker: Mipham
notes: Reference from the unit author's knowledge (not read in a local text in this phase).
